title: gonarch's lair (ft. Feather)
lyrics: When I pulled the sword from the stone
A stormy night, A haunted tune
Two doors shut on the flame
No name to conquer the pain
Piano man plays through the dialtone
As biker gangs descend from Ravenholme
Yeah, Black Ops hit the black top
In the black gulch, just to plug the Rot
Fuck these metros, I won't fail
Smoke a bitch in the big house
Then run it back, let the coppers joust
No apologies for the blank flanks
Took 'bucka down just to hang blanks
Never knew me 'till the ship sank
Killed a headcrab for a blank slate
Yeah Interrobang be like Corner Folk
Clock a bitch 'till he's on the ropes
I did his tricks, I hit his dope
Put him on the list, so flies the crow
So flies the crow like a bullet
But in change he ain't affluent, uh
Going down and out on the undertow
'Till I drag 'em down like a siren
Scale every cell for the redhats
For the fires they're first in line in
So then, paper men were shouting
About a girl they never knew
Screaming at children on the news
As the biker men stripped ones and twos
On the news, on the news
Under the heat of our sons
Rending alien earth in its wake
Walls of flesh and crimson shade
I went and killed the person that I were
Slaying every heretic that still worships her
'Don't you dare go hollow, gunning metros down'
Fuck the sorry sod, unburdened with patience
Saw her standing there, Hyena laugh
And as her pleas elapsed, at last undone
I saw her raise her fist, and black out the sun
Dog of circumstance, I pity you
But don't mistake this mercy killing
Because heretics hail and herald your name
Bring out my dead, and your corpse profane
Dulled the blade against the renegade
Now I'm sharp again, make your play
Now we pray and spray on white crusades
Every war was started by a man
Put a flag up everytime he went
'Till there's no trace of him left
Lord of Cinder, strike a smile
Your darkest souls will all be spent
That epidemic gotta stay in style
Every biker man will be slaughtered
Every banker man will be hung
Every flaghoister, pale cloister, red oyster
Push the boys to their limits
When you know just what you do?
Counting, or not counting your bitches?
